title: Model match · Level 1: The free motor's step
brief: Predict a step of the free EV3 Medium on port 3 of the class robot, from rest. The course sets line 1 to `d = <duty>`, drawn 25 to 90 % per run. Before the step, write your model's 201 predictions of Motor(3).speed() in deg/s, for t = 0, 0.002, ..., 0.4 s, to the flash file predict.txt (numbers separated by blanks, commas or new lines); then call Motor(3).dc(d) and hold it, the program still running (a wait past the window): the run ends 0.4 s after the step. The course reads Motor(3).speed() every 2 ms from the step (t = 0 is the reading before the duty acts) to 0.4 s, both included. NRMSE = rms(prediction - reading) / y_ss, y_ss the mean of the last 50 ms, both ends (26 readings); a run scores 100 x clamp(1 - NRMSE / 0.15, 0, 1), and 0 when the step is not dc(d) held to the end, when a built-in move ran on port 3, or when any other motor (ports 1, 2, 4) drew energy. Ten runs; pass: a mean of 60 or more and 8 runs predicted. Practice until COURSE ships. The identification check (a card line, not the score): also write your K (deg/s per V), tau (s) and u_f (V), three numbers, to model.txt before the step (u = d / 100 x battery.voltage() / 1000); the card shows them beside the course's own, fitted to its ten steps (the y_ss line over u, tau the 63.2 % time), and matches 1 when K and tau are within 10 % and u_f within 0.15 V of its fit (over the runs that score). On one simulated motor it tells whether your numbers describe it, not who found them (the lessons print numbers for this motor). Par: the reference model's mean score on seed 0, 99.3 (mean NRMSE 0.11 %).

score.run: if(predicted & stepped & stepHeld & stepDuty == d & moveTicks == 0 & energy_1 == 0 & energy_2 == 0 & energy_4 == 0, 100 * clamp(1 - nrmse / 0.15, 0, 1), 0)

idK.value: if(count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) >= 2 & (count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) * sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, (r.d * r.stepV / 100) ^ 2, 0)) - sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.d * r.stepV / 100, 0)) ^ 2) > 0, (count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) * sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.d * r.stepV / 100 * r.ySs, 0)) - sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.d * r.stepV / 100, 0)) * sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.ySs, 0))) / (count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) * sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, (r.d * r.stepV / 100) ^ 2, 0)) - sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.d * r.stepV / 100, 0)) ^ 2), 0)
idK.undefinedWhen: count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) < 2 | (count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) * sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, (r.d * r.stepV / 100) ^ 2, 0)) - sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.d * r.stepV / 100, 0)) ^ 2) <= 0

idUf.value: if(count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) >= 2 & idK > 0, sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.d * r.stepV / 100, 0)) / count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) - sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.ySs, 0)) / (count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) * idK), 0)
idUf.undefinedWhen: count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) < 2 | (count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) * sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, (r.d * r.stepV / 100) ^ 2, 0)) - sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.d * r.stepV / 100, 0)) ^ 2) <= 0 | idK <= 0

idTauMs.value: if(count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0 & r.tau63 >= 0) >= 1, 1000 * sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0 & r.tau63 >= 0, r.tau63, 0)) / count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0 & r.tau63 >= 0), 0)
idTauMs.undefinedWhen: count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0 & r.tau63 >= 0) < 1

yourK.value: if(count(r in runs: r.params) >= 1, sum(r in runs: if(r.params, r.teamK, 0)) / count(r in runs: r.params), 0)

yourTauMs.value: if(count(r in runs: r.params) >= 1, 1000 * sum(r in runs: if(r.params, r.teamTau, 0)) / count(r in runs: r.params), 0)

yourUf.value: if(count(r in runs: r.params) >= 1, sum(r in runs: if(r.params, r.teamUf, 0)) / count(r in runs: r.params), 0)

matches.value: if(abs(yourK - idK) <= 0.1 * idK & abs(yourTauMs - idTauMs) <= 0.1 * idTauMs & abs(yourUf - idUf) <= 0.15, 1, 0)
matches.undefinedWhen: count(r in runs: r.params) < 1 | count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) < 2 | (count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0) * sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, (r.d * r.stepV / 100) ^ 2, 0)) - sum(r in runs: if(r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0, r.d * r.stepV / 100, 0)) ^ 2) <= 0 | idK <= 0 | count(r in runs: r.predicted & r.stepped & r.stepHeld & r.stepDuty == r.d & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.energy_1 == 0 & r.energy_2 == 0 & r.energy_4 == 0 & r.tau63 >= 0) < 1
